definition: Full file or directory path to source artifact; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Exact column name, JSON key, configuration key, or code variable being defined.
Plain-language meaning of the field and what one recorded value represents.
Data type of the field, such as string, integer, float, Boolean, list, or object.
Complete set of permitted categorical or coded values, with the meaning of each value.
Measurement unit for numeric values; state unitless when no unit applies.
Meaning of blank, null, NA, sentinel, or otherwise missing values for this field.
Original source columns, files, or code variables from which this field was copied or derived.
Exact formula or transformation used to derive this field; state not derived for source fields.
Full file or directory path to field derivation code; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Exact benchmark list: IAT 60-word test, VisBias, DecodingTrust, and BOLD.
Exact input-set list: 12-image set, FairFace, and UTKFace.
Full file or directory path to test matrix manifest; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Identifiers for benchmark-by-input-set test cells that have complete, interpretable results.
Identifiers for required test cells that have not been run or finished.
Identifiers for matrix cells that cannot logically be run; give the reason in the cell record.
Identifiers for completed cells whose outputs or scores cannot be interpreted reliably.
Exact human-readable name of benchmark.
Direct URL for benchmark source.
Exact version or immutable revision of benchmark.
Exact benchmark tasks or subsets used; do not report only the parent benchmark name.
Full file or directory path to benchmark item manifest; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Full file or directory path to benchmark prompt template; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Full file or directory path to benchmark input construction code; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Full file or directory path to benchmark scoring formula; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Full file or directory path to benchmark scoring code; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Meaning of larger, smaller, positive, negative, and zero scores for this benchmark.
Exact rule that removes benchmark items, model outputs, or runs from analysis.
Exact rule used to combine item-level scores into the reported benchmark result.
Only protocol details needed to interpret or reproduce this benchmark implementation.
Number of attribute words used in the IAT evaluation; confirm whether this is exactly 60.
Full file or directory path to iat positive word list; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Full file or directory path to iat negative word list; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Exact demographic target groups and contrast direction used in the IAT score.
Full file or directory path to iat prompt template; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Full file or directory path to iat score formula; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Plain-language interpretation of positive, negative, and zero IAT scores.
Rule used to pair or balance images across the IAT target groups.
Rule or seed controlling the order of IAT words, prompts, and images.
Exact condition under which an IAT response, image, or item is excluded.
Whether all IAT protocol choices were fixed before inspecting the final comparison results.
Whether the IAT task itself was used as a DPO training objective or example source.
Whether any examples from the IAT evaluation set appeared in DPO training data.
Exact human-readable name of input set.
Direct URL for input set source.
Exact version or immutable revision of input set.
Full file or directory path to input set source manifest; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Full root-directory path containing input set local; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Number of examples in the final input set after documented exclusions.
Exact rule determining which source examples are omitted from this input set.
Full file or directory path to input set final test manifest; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Names and meanings of the demographic label columns used from this input set.
Full file or directory path to input set label mapping; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Full file or directory path to input set image preprocessing config; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Whether any image or person appears in both relevant training and evaluation data, and how this was checked.
Only limitations or construction details needed to interpret this input set.
Stable identifier for one benchmark × input-set × model-condition result.
Exact human-readable name of benchmark.
Exact human-readable name of input set.
Exact condition name, such as base model, prompted model, or selected DPO checkpoint.
Full checkpoint path for a local model, or exact hosted-model and API version for a remote model.
Status of this test cell: complete, not completed, not applicable, or not interpretable.
Reason a test cell is unfinished or inapplicable; leave blank only for completed cells.
Number of evaluated units contributing to this reported test result.
Full file or directory path to test prompt; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Full file or directory path to test evaluation config; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Exact executable command used for test execution.
Exact Git commit SHA for test code.
Random seed controlling sampling, generation, or evaluation for this test cell.
Exact name of the reported metric for this test cell.
Operational definition and calculation of the reported test metric.
Meaning of higher, lower, positive, negative, and zero values for this metric.
Unrounded reported metric value for this test cell.
Method used to quantify uncertainty, including interval level and resampling unit if applicable.
Unrounded confidence interval, standard error, or other uncertainty result.
Full file or directory path to test raw model output; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Full file or directory path to test row level score; also provide a repository or data link when available.
One-sentence factual summary of the result without adding an unsupported causal claim.
Limits on what this test result can support or compare.
Stable identifier for dpo preference dataset.
Exact human-readable name of dpo source dataset.
Direct URL for dpo source dataset.
Exact version or immutable revision of dpo source dataset.

Number of source FairFace images considered before DPO-data exclusions.
Number of FairFace images retained to create the DPO preference data.
Number of candidate FairFace images excluded from DPO-data construction.

Exact models used to produce candidate responses before preference selection.
Full file or directory path to dpo response generation config; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Number of candidate responses generated for each source image and prompt condition.
Procedure used to decide which response was preferred, including whether it was human, model, rule, or hybrid based.
Exact criterion used to assign the chosen response in each preference pair.
Exact criterion used to assign the rejected response in each preference pair.
Whether humans contributed preference labels, review, correction, or adjudication.
Full file or directory path to dpo annotator instruction; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Total number of retained chosen–rejected preference pairs.
Number of preference pairs used for DPO parameter updates.
Number of held-out preference pairs used during DPO validation or checkpoint selection.

SHA-256 checksum verifying the exact bytes of dpo preference data.
Full file or directory path to dpo data creation code; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Exact executable command that recreates the DPO preference dataset from its recorded inputs.
Stable identifier for the one successful DPO run selected for reporting.
Rule used to select this run over other successful versions; do not provide the excluded versions unless they are relevant failures.

Exact version or immutable revision of dpo base model.

Exact version or immutable revision of dpo tokenizer.

Exact optimization objective implemented for the selected DPO run.

Exact Git commit SHA for dpo code.
Full file or directory path to dpo training config; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Exact executable command used to launch the selected DPO run.
Primary random seed supplied to the selected DPO training run.
DPO beta value controlling preference-objective strength relative to the reference model.
Exact optimizer implementation used for parameter updates.
Optimizer learning rate used for the selected DPO run.
Rule used to change the learning rate over DPO training steps.
Fraction of training steps allocated to learning-rate warmup.
Weight-decay coefficient applied by the optimizer.
Number of full passes over the DPO training pairs.
Total optimizer-update steps completed in the selected DPO run.
Examples processed per device before gradient accumulation.
Number of microbatches accumulated before one optimizer update.
Total examples contributing to one optimizer update across devices and accumulation steps.
Maximum token sequence length accepted during DPO training.
Maximum gradient norm or value permitted before clipping.
Numeric precision used during training, such as BF16 or FP16.
Model modules to which LoRA adapters were applied.
Rank of the low-rank LoRA matrices.
LoRA scaling parameter used for adapter updates.
Dropout probability applied within LoRA adapters.
Exact accelerator type and model used for the selected run.
Number of accelerators used simultaneously.
Full file or directory path to dpo environment lock; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Direct URL for dpo tracking dashboard.
Full file or directory path to dpo training metric export; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Full file or directory path to dpo final checkpoint; also provide a repository or data link when available.
SHA-256 checksum verifying the exact bytes of dpo final checkpoint.
Predefined rule used to select the reported final checkpoint.
Elapsed wall-clock duration of the selected DPO run, including the unit.
Explicit criteria used to classify the selected run as successful.
Full file or directory path to dpo success evidence; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Exact name of one training metric that was actually monitored or used.
Operational definition of the DPO training metric, not only its display label.
Formula, library definition, or code location that produces the training metric.
Meaning of increasing or decreasing values for the training metric.
Measurement unit of the training metric, or unitless if applicable.
Training-step or epoch frequency at which the metric was recorded.
Full file or directory path to dpo metric history; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Unrounded final value of the metric for the selected run.
Unrounded best value and the step at which it occurred, if used for selection.
What this metric shows about the selected run and what it does not establish.
Exact name of one metric the RA actually used to detect generic, repetitive, invalid, or otherwise collapsed outputs.
Operational definition of the collapse indicator, including preprocessing and denominator.
Full file or directory path to anti collapse metric formula; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Full file or directory path to anti collapse metric code; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Full file or directory path to anti collapse input data; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Model conditions compared by this metric, such as base versus selected DPO checkpoint.
When the metric was measured: during training, during checkpoint selection, or after training.
Unrounded metric value for each compared model condition.
Threshold or qualitative rule used to flag collapse or reject a checkpoint; state none if no rule existed.
Whether this metric flagged the selected checkpoint as collapsed, borderline, or acceptable.
Evidence-based interpretation of the metric for the selected checkpoint.
Known behaviors this metric cannot detect or distinguish.
Description of the RA's existing anti-collapse method when it differs from the requested fields; preserve its original terminology.
Stable identifier for the evaluation campaign run after DPO.
Full file or directory path to post dpo checkpoint; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Exact model conditions included in post-DPO comparisons.
Benchmarks rerun after DPO.
Input sets rerun after DPO.
Full file or directory path to post dpo test matrix manifest; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Whether post-DPO evaluation used exactly the same prompts, items, scoring, and exclusions as pre-DPO evaluation.
Every protocol change made between pre-DPO and post-DPO evaluation, with its reason.
Full file or directory path to post dpo evaluation config; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Exact Git commit SHA for post dpo code.
Exact executable command used for post dpo execution.
Random seed used for the post-DPO evaluation campaign.

Full root-directory path containing post dpo row level result; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Small set of metrics used for the main post-DPO conclusions.
Short factual summary of the main post-DPO results across the reported test matrix.
Limits on comparing post-DPO results with pre-DPO or other model conditions.
Stable identifier for one pre-DPO versus post-DPO primary comparison.
Exact human-readable name of comparison benchmark.
Exact human-readable name of comparison input set.
Independent unit used in the comparison, such as image, person, prompt, or run.
Unrounded result for the designated pre-DPO or base model condition.
Unrounded result for the selected post-DPO checkpoint.
Which numerical direction represents improvement for this comparison.
Exact paired or unpaired statistical comparison and uncertainty method used.
Unrounded interval, standard error, test statistic, and p-value when applicable.
Full file or directory path to comparison result; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Full file or directory path to comparison code; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Exact executable command that recreates this comparison from row-level results.
Evidence-supported interpretation of the comparison without overstating causality.
Whether the change in the target result coincided with worse output diversity, validity, refusal, or another monitored collapse indicator.
Stable identifier for a failed trial included because it explains the selected pipeline.
What the failed trial was intended to improve or test.
Single most relevant change from the successful or parent run.
Directly observed behavior that made the trial unsuccessful.
Criterion used to label the trial unsuccessful.
Full file or directory path to failed trial evidence; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Only the metrics needed to demonstrate the reported failure.
Unrounded values of the metrics used to demonstrate the failure.
Best current explanation supported by available evidence, clearly distinguished from a proven cause.
Confidence in the proposed explanation and the evidence basis for that confidence.
Specific change or decision in the selected pipeline that was informed by this failed trial.
Full file or directory path to failed trial code or config; also provide a repository or data link when available.
Why this failure is necessary to understand the successful pipeline; omit the trial if no clear reason exists.
Relevant failure details that are genuinely unknown or were not recorded.

Result or comparison the plot is intended to communicate.
